doc.title: Mode template — AI-Assisted Scoping Review
doc.markdown:
# Mode template — AI-Assisted Scoping Review > Aplica-se quando `review_type: scoping_review` no metadado do manuscrito. > Combinar com o template-base (manuscript-template.html) — este arquivo descreve apenas as especificidades do modo. ## Selo obrigatório no header do manuscrito ```html
AI-Assisted Scoping Review following PRISMA-ScR (Tricco et al. 2018) + JBI Manual cap. 11 Single-reviewer with LLM-assisted screening (full transparency in §03 / Reproducibility Package).
``` Estilo CSS sugerido (cor distinta para cada modo — scoping = azul/teal): ```css .review-mode-badge.mode-scoping { background: #e0f7fa; border-left: 4px solid #00838f; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; } ``` ## Seções obrigatórias específicas Além das seções padrão do manuscript-template, este modo exige: ### §02.x — Justificativa do escopo (não systematic) Texto-padrão a inserir (ajustar ao tema): > "This review is reported as a Scoping Review, not a Systematic Review, by deliberate methodological choice. The author is the sole reviewer; LLM-assisted screening was used with full transparency (see Reproducibility Package). Per PRISMA-ScR (Tricco et al. 2018) and JBI Manual chapter 11, single-reviewer scoping reviews are methodologically acceptable when limitations are explicitly declared. Should this body of evidence later require systematic-review-level rigor (e.g., for clinical guidance), an upgrade with two independent human reviewers is the appropriate path." ### §03 — Declaração de uso de IAG (modo scoping) Texto-padrão: > "**Declaration of AI use** — Generative AI (specify model: e.g., Claude Opus 4.7, OpenAI GPT-X) was used for the following stages: search query expansion (with human validation), title/abstract screening (with human dual-check on a stratified random sample of N=15% of records), data extraction template assistance, and synthesis drafting. The AI was NOT used for: critical appraisal scoring, discussion content judgment, or final inclusion decisions on borderline cases. The complete prompt sequences, model parameters (temperature, top_p, seed when available), and validation logs are deposited in the Reproducibility Package (Zenodo DOI: [to be filled after deposit])." ### §04.x — Limitações específicas do scoping mode Texto-padrão a adicionar à seção de limitações: > "Methodological limitations specific to scoping methodology: (i) critical appraisal of individual sources is reported but not used as exclusion criterion (per PRISMA-ScR); (ii) synthesis is descriptive/thematic rather than meta-analytic; (iii) single-reviewer screening was mitigated by AI-assisted dual-checking but does not fully replicate independent two-human-reviewer consensus." ## Reporting guideline aplicável `PRISMA-ScR` (22 items) — perfil em `references/profiles/_guidelines/prisma-scr.yaml`. ## Selos no metadado YAML do manuscrito ```yaml review_type: scoping_review review_purpose: design_foundational # ou design_validation, design_correction, independent_inquiry reporting_guideline_primary: PRISMA-ScR reporting_guideline_secondary: [] reviewer_count_human: 1 reviewer_count_ai: 1 ai_dual_check_sample_pct: 15 # mínimo recomendado two_reviewer_kappa_documented: false title_must_contain: "Scoping Review" # ou "scoping" em PT/ES ```
